chunks: And Musa ibn al-Qasim narrated from Ibn Jabalah, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, from Abū al-Ḥasan (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Ascend from Wadi ʿUrnah with ʿArafāt."

key_terms.ارْتَفِعُوا: Ascend or go up, a command indicating movement from a lower station to a higher one.
key_terms.عَرَفَاتٍ: ʿArafāt, the sacred plain and station of Hajj; here used to denote the ritual state or location associated with the Day of ʿArafāt.
key_terms.وَادِي عُرَنَةَ: Wadi ʿUrnah, a valley near Mecca where pilgrims traditionally perform specific rites before entering the state of ʿArafāt.

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on ascending from Wadi ʿUrnah during Hajj?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith clarifies the precise geographical and temporal boundaries of the *wuquf* (standing) at ʿArafāt, a cornerstone of Hajj validity. It establishes that the ritual ascent from Wadi ʿUrnah marks the entry into the sacred station, ensuring pilgrims remain within the designated area for the essential act of worship. This ruling underscores the scholarly emphasis on adhering to the Prophet’s specific instructions regarding the physical movement of pilgrims during the Hajj rites.
